subject: SIG access evidence & provisioning plan for FinOps POC
messages:
From: Tara Liu <tara.liu@finops.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finops.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up: SSO / SCIM / RBAC evidence for POC

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the FinOps product team is excited to proceed with the POC. Before we spin up test users on our side, our security team asked for a few clarifications for the SIG we received:

1) SSO/SAML: can you confirm whether Redwood supports SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SSO, and whether certificate rotation is automated or manual? We also need an example of SAML metadata and the typical TTL for SAML assertions.

2) SCIM / provisioning: does Redwood support incremental SCIM syncs (delta) and does the service expose SCIM 2.0 patch semantics for group membership? We would like a short diagram of the provisioning flow for delegated admins.

3) RBAC / least privilege: for the POC we plan to create a handful of roles. Please share a sample role-to-permission mapping and any guidance you have for least-privilege defaults.

4) MFA: is MFA enforced at account level, and do you support conditional MFA (e.g., step-up for admin consoles)? Any snippet of the policy is helpful.

If you can reply with the high-level answers and attach any short artifacts (SCIM flow diagram, sample metadata, and a filled SIG tab) that would be ideal. We have a security review on Monday 15th and it would help to have the artifacts by EOD Friday 12th PST.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Tara
Tara Liu
Security Engineer, FinOps Inc.

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Tara Liu <tara.liu@finops.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 14:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SSO / SCIM / RBAC evidence for POC

Hi Tara — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Dev (ID/Infra) and Marissa (Customer Success) — we can provide the artifacts and a short plan. High-level answers below; detailed artifacts attached.

1) SSO/SAML: Redwood supports both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SSO. Certificate rotation is supported via API and can be automated through our key management integration (KMS/HSM), but customers can also rotate manually via Console. SAML assertion TTL is configurable; default is 5 minutes. Attached: sample_saml_metadata.xml.

2) SCIM / provisioning: We implement SCIM 2.0 with support for incremental (delta) syncs and PATCH semantics for group membership. Provisioning flows include inbound SCIM from IdP to Redwood and outbound deprovisioning hooks for downstream systems. Attached: scim_provisioning_flow.png (simple diagram) and FinOps_SIG_answers_v1.xlsx (SIG tabs completed for access controls).

3) RBAC / least privilege: Redwood ships with several opinionated roles (Viewer, Developer, Model Admin, Org Admin). For POC we recommend starting with Viewer + scoped Developer roles, granting Model Admin only to a small subset. See attached worksheet for role-permission matrix excerpt. Least-privilege guidance: avoid Org Admin except for initial setup; use resource-level scoping and time-limited elevated roles.

4) MFA: MFA is enforced at the org level for Redwood Managed accounts; we also support conditional step-up MFA for sensitive console paths via our policy engine (e.g., require step-up when accessing keys or billing). Attached: mfa_policy_snippet.txt (policy excerpt).

Next steps: Dev, can you confirm whether the SCIM delta syncs require any custom headers for FinOps IdP? Also Marissa — can we schedule a 30m sync Tue 16th to walk the security team through artifacts?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Attachments: FinOps_SIG_answers_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), scim_provisioning_flow.png (image/png), mfa_policy_snippet.txt (text/plain)

From: dev.patel@redwood.ai
To: Tara Liu <tara.liu@finops.com>, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SSO / SCIM / RBAC evidence for POC

Tara — quick follow-up from engineering: SCIM delta syncs follow RFC 7644 patterns and we include an incremental token in the response header (X-Redwood-Delta-Token). No custom headers required from your IdP to initiate a delta; standard Authorization (Bearer) + Content-Type are sufficient. For group PATCH semantics we support add/remove operations against group.members.

We will also provide a short Postman collection if you want to exercise the calls against a staging tenant.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Engineering Manager, Identity Platform
Redwood Inference
